project_type: Ruby on Rails backend + React/TypeScript frontend (Mastodon social network)
build_system: bundler for Ruby, yarn for JS. No special build quirks for this task.
test_framework: RSpec for Ruby (bundle exec rspec), Vitest for JS (yarn test)
build_command: bundle exec rails assets:precompile (not needed for this task)
test_command: bundle exec rspec spec/ (Ruby), yarn test (JS)
verification_instructions: 1. Run specific Ruby specs for new controllers/models. 2. Run yarn test for frontend changes. 3. yarn lint for linting.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. Standard Ruby/Node environment.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing code patterns. Match existing style. SCSS changes: only fix exact error location.
key_patterns: Redis sorted sets for feeds (FeedManager pattern: key=feed:{type}:{id}, zadd/zrem/zrangebyscore). API controllers extend Api::BaseController. Notifications v2 uses grouped notifications. Frontend uses Redux Toolkit with createDataLoadingThunk pattern. IconButton component for action buttons. Sidekiq workers for async jobs.
directory_structure: app/controllers/api/ - API controllers (v1/, v2/ namespaces). app/models/ - ActiveRecord models. app/services/ - Service objects. app/lib/ - Library code (FeedManager). app/workers/ - Sidekiq background workers. app/serializers/rest/ - JSON serializers. config/routes/ - Route definitions (api.rb, web_app.rb). app/javascript/mastodon/ - Frontend React app (features/, actions/, reducers/, api/, selectors/, components/).
